summary.CURRENT_FUNDING_TX_SHOULD_REMAIN_VISIBLE: Yes, as an advanced/technical retained-evidence field; it must not stand in for either economic leg.
summary.IMPLEMENTATION_BOUNDARY: A read-only adapter can join existing wt_walkback_transaction_roles, wt_walkback_atomic_flows and retained bounded-RPC audit corpus. Any later durable production projection/schema change needs separate authorization.
summary.ROLE_AWARE_UI_MODEL: For each protected mint, render two independently sourced evidence cards: Upstream funding and Creator provisioning. Each card displays its explicit state and never derives the other card from subprov, timing, funder_wallet, or selected-hop semantics. Preserve current selected signature as technical evidence only.
